stories.title: Bank of Canada faces trade‑off between weak economy and rising inflation
stories.summary: Canada’s economy remains weak while inflation rose to 3.1 % in the most recent month. Core‑inflation measures that exclude volatile items stayed subdued, and the Bank of Canada must decide on Wednesday whether to raise rates, which would further weaken growth, or cut rates, which could let inflation rise further.
stories.why: Inflation data can shift expectations for central-bank interest rates, bond yields, borrowing costs and household purchasing power.

stories.title: Chris Brown receives suspended eight‑month sentence for London nightclub assault
stories.summary: US singer Chris Brown avoided immediate jail after being sentenced to eight months in prison, suspended for 12 months, for striking a man twice in the head with a glass tequila bottle at the private members’ club Tape in Mayfair during the early hours of 19 February 2023. His vocal coach, rapper Omololu Akinlolu, was given a four‑month suspended sentence; both pleaded guilty to affray and were ordered to pay £1,500 costs.
stories.why: The case shows that high‑profile individuals can face legal consequences for violent conduct in the UK.

stories.title: Health worker killed and another injured in Ebola response attack in north‑eastern DRC
stories.summary: A nurse was killed and a second health worker seriously injured when local youths attacked them while they were responding to an Ebola alert in north‑eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The youths accused the responders of contaminating water and spreading Ebola, according to UN‑backed Radio Okapi. The World Health Organization condemned the attack, and Uganda banned non‑essential travel to and from the DRC and will quarantine returning citizens for 21 days.
stories.why: This matters because it could expand treatment options or demonstrate a clinically meaningful new medical technology.

stories.title: RBI steps up liquidity support as tighter cash conditions push up borrowing rates: Report
stories.summary: Tightening liquidity in the banking system has pushed up short-term borrowing rates, prompting the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to inject funds into banks, according to an ICICI Bank report. The report expects the 10-year benchmark bond yield to trade between 7.40% and 7.60% in the near term.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: India’s outward FDI falls 14% to $4.34 billion in September
stories.summary: Outward foreign direct investment from India declined by 14% in September, reaching $4.34 billion. The fall coincided with a reduction in outbound loans and guarantees during the same period, according to the Economic Times. The data reflect a slowdown in the country’s external capital deployment for that month.
stories.why: The decline influences India’s balance of payments and its overall participation in global investment flows.
